items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-09-01
items.q: And the boys was in there playing. And for some reason, I seen a trumpet laying on the table, you know? And I just couldn't resist. I picked up the trumpet and went to blowing.

ctx.x: I know that then. I know that then. I know that I had a gallstone. And they tried to give me medicine to pass it out, you know?

Well, I wouldn't say they're trying to give me medicine to pass it out, because the doctors were taking extra of me every day and they couldn't find out what we were on. Took me all kind of ways, couldn't find me. They did find out they laid about six or four little pillars, you know? And told me they lay with my back right on them. They took x-ray from the side. They took x-ray from the side. They found out under the liver, the gallstone was under my liver. Oh. It was under there. Oh. And they said I had a…
I was there, but I didn't know it was you. You was there?
